comparison: Against control atlas (0/48 PASS, 48 BLOCKED on ordinary tasks), prior_mechanism removes MoG standardization cross-row Jacobian coupling while satisfying stochastic prior contracts, turning 0/48 into 6 PASS across 19 executed tasks and passing held vector_anisotropic (mass_tv=0.0058 vs BISPF 0.191 / BCAP 0.196 FAIL) and vector_overlap (PASS vs BISPF/BCAP drift FAIL). Against bispf-optimized-quintic-v1 (20 PASS, 16 FAIL, 1 BLOCKED, 2 INCOMPLETE on prior-ablation-full-suite-v1), unchanged Atlas fails clean within-mode covariance gates on grid100/rotated100/staggered100 (cov_trace_bias -0.695 to -0.751) and ring16_acquisition (cov_err=0.6067) strictly because Atlas preset output_noise_std=0.029 supplies ~93% of 0.030-sigma mode variance during training that clean (output_noise=False) evaluation strips.
conclusion: Full-suite diagnostic (prior-ablation-full-suite-v1, seed 0, deterministic_orthogonal): technique-owned prior_mechanism (unstandardized ParticlePrior + NormalNoiseManipulator sigma=0.005, deterministic sigma=0.0 on enumerated image tasks) with unchanged atlas preset recipe unblocked all 25 public_trainer tasks (19 executed, 6 continuations gated by parent clean-variance verdicts, 23 non-policy/unrouted hosts blocked). Both study signatures confirmed: grid100 precision=0.99737 (>=0.95, 100/100 modes, mass_tv=0.02576, center_rms_sigma=0.13426; rotated100 precision=0.9993, staggered100 precision=0.9969) and gaussian1d_smoke mean_error_sigma=0.0052 (<=0.20 PASS). Total 6 PASS (gaussian1d_smoke, vector_two_broad, vector_anisotropic mass_tv=0.0058, vector_overlap, vector_spiral, img_stripes2 hq=1.0000), 12 FAIL, 1 runtime BLOCKED (zero_tanh_smoke), 29 preflight/dependency not run.

decision_outcomes.reuse_note: Compatible original receipts; overlapping readouts are not independent runs or additive costs

hypothesis: Swapping MoGParticlePrior for a technique-owned unstandardized ParticlePrior plus NormalNoiseManipulator (sigma=0.005) unblocks public_trainer execution across the 48-task full suite while keeping the public atlas preset recipe fixed under protocol seed 0.
next_action: Test a clean-training Atlas study (output_noise_mode='fixed', output_noise_std=0.0 paired with prior_mechanism NormalNoiseManipulator sigma=0.005 and min(birth_death_cells, num_particles // 2) cell cap) so the generator carries full within-mode variance under clean evaluation without altering row-local particle transport.

study.competing_explanation: Remaining failures on clean-evaluated Gaussian covariance trace gates stem from Atlas preset output_noise_std=0.029 absorbing training variance that is stripped during clean (output_noise=False) evaluation, or from public_components hosts lacking the UpdatePolicy lifecycle, rather than prior cross-row coupling.
